subject: Data Engineering
title: Inconsistent Data Across Systems
description: A quick win: understand Inconsistent Data Across Systems.

hook.text: The CRM says 10K active users. The billing system says 9.5K. The CEO asks: which one is right?

buildup.text: Inconsistency happens when multiple systems store the same entity with different definitions or timing.

discovery.text: Root causes include different update schedules, varying business logic, and siloed data ownership.

twist.text: Declaring one system the 'source of truth' sounds easy until two teams each claim theirs is correct.

climax.text: Conformed definitions, shared keys, and a single authoritative source per entity resolve conflicts.

punchline.text: One entity, one truth. Everything else is a copy.

quiz.question: What is the primary cause of data inconsistency across systems?
options: Different definitions and update schedules for the same entity
Using the same database for everything
